claimAudit.claim: Call volume rather than request cost is the real problem
claimAudit.verdict: Both matter: serial occupancy is request demand times latency, plus other work and burst/queue effects. Saved numbers support excessive workload.

Not established. poseCache is keyed by frame index and shared across all checks, including empty poses. Overlapping windows reuse entries. Need per-consumer demand/miss/hit attribution; high unique-call coverage is not a low cache-hit ratio.

claimAudit.claim: GPU contention explains slowdown and365ms spike
claimAudit.verdict: Unproven. 40.08vs15.31ms penalty persists in the isolated probe with no RF-DETR workload. Contention may contribute under concurrency but requires profiling.
Plausible target, not guarantee: estimate falls from916to458ms/source-second native; other work, bursts, tails, false/missed contacts must be checked.

Observed average gap3.79ms at512,3.69at768 in selected fixed-image probe. Async refactor changes scheduling, ownership/cancellation and backpressure; separate serial executor alone does not eliminate waiting. Full pipeline benefit unmeasured.

claimAudit.claim: Holistic hands cost7.6ms and help association
claimAudit.verdict: 7.61ms observed512 average marginal cost,6.24ms at768. Actual hands associated with body are promising; existing code must consume them. Blanket use can cost more than current conditional hand inference.

claimAudit.claim: Resolution or ROI cannot improve speed
claimAudit.verdict: 512and768 showed near-equal request timings for9images. No ROI speed ablation; total preprocessing and person-count effects untested. Larger input produced more empty modern poses on these selected images.

claimAudit.claim: All extra losses were handsNearBall and phone17 is fine
claimAudit.verdict: Overstated.21extra misses:6handsNearBall,3missingBall,3insufficientContactViews,3amplitudeTooSmall,3noNearbyCandidate,2trackLost,1unresolvedLowContact. Nearest diagnostics are hints.20short clips do not qualify15minute capture or imports.
